title: My game has multiplayer where you can prompt a spell for anything. It's getting pretty chaotic, but fun.  I got turned into a potato at the end.
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
* Prompt any spell and use it in a 3D physics based world
* Full multiplayer support for up to 6 players with VoIP
* All made with ThreeJS and Colyseus

[https://spellwright.xyz/](https://spellwright.xyz/)

comments.author: Velvet-Thunder-RIP
comments.body: Curious. Wouldnt prompting for every spell cause you to lose focus on the fight? Wouldnt someone who sticks with a simple fireball spell have an advantage in general since tey can just keep using it?

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body: Lots to explore still, we are thinking you might get word credits in a single player mode. Then you can set your spell load out before you start an MP battle. But still exploring this.

replies.author: Velvet-Thunder-RIP
replies.body:
I do a lot of AI engineering analysis, building, and implementation for a company. If you ever wanna talk through some ideas id love to talk. I love the idea and am curious about how it could translate into real game mechanics. I was even thinking about how you could apply it to potions or transfiguration spells. 

Like I am looking into local LLMs semi due to another convo we had about this game.

comments.author: Hyphysaurusrex
comments.body:
Ok, I had fun. Played for 20 minutes with some randoms. Wasn't long until giant dicks and tits were crushing players on the field. 10/10 for my tits attack being called Monstrous Smother.

  
Maybe set some parameters? Not sure if you're okay with the NSFW content but just a heads up. 

  
Some fun spells I made:

  
Arcane Blink (blink in any direction of WASD input)

Wall of Flame

Orbital Strike

Murder of Crows 

Summon Godzilla (summoned a giant black capsule that would shoot out projectiles like a turret lol)

Vine Root

Electric Field 

  
I think this has tons of potential! Maybe create a Wizard Workshop mode where wizards can practice weaving spells, saving their toolkits, and taking them to the battlefield. Would be cool if they could even showcase their skills, get them attributed in game so other players can recognize them, etc. Will be back for more chaos!
